_about: Hand-written 'How it's built' for lesson characters where Make Me a Hanzi has an unknown part (？) or only a one-word hint. scripts/gen-charinfo.mjs applies these over the dictionary: parts (a character, or {c, py, en} when the dictionary lacks it) and hint replace its own.

久.hint: Once a person (人) with a mark on the back, from moxibustion (灸 = 久 + 火), a slow treatment: a long time.

也.hint: An old drawing (some say of a snake, some of a water jug), borrowed for its sound: also. It is the sound part of 他, 她, 地 and 池.

弟.hint: A cord wound round a stick, one turn after another (it looks like 弓, a bow): order, so the brother who comes next.

那.hint: The left side is an old form of 冄; 阝 on the right is 邑, a town. It first named a place, then was borrowed for 'that'.

习.hint: Short for 習: 羽 (wings) over 白. A young bird flapping its wings again and again: to practise. 习 keeps one half of 羽.

有.hint: A hand (又, written ナ here) holding 月, a piece of meat: to have. 又 (yòu) also gives the sound.

发.hint: Simplified from two characters: 發, to shoot (弓 bow, 癶 feet), and 髮, hair. 发 is a quick handwritten form of 發.

每.hint: The top was once 屮, a sprout: grass growing thick. 母 (mǔ) below gives the sound. Later borrowed for 'every'.

后.hint: A person (the bent top) with 口, a mouth giving orders: a ruler, later a queen (皇后). It is also the simple form of 後, behind.

右.hint: A right hand (又, written ナ here) and 口, the mouth: hand and mouth helping each other. Compare 左, the hand over 工.

以.hint: The left part is an old drawing of a plough; 人 on the right is the person working with it: to use, by means of.

单.hint: Simplified from 單, an old drawing of a forked hunting tool: two prongs (丷) on a shaft. 'Single, alone' is a later meaning.

用.hint: An old drawing of a wooden bucket with its handle, the thing you use every day: to use.

方.hint: An old drawing, most likely a plough with its handle (亠) on top. From the square plots it turned came 'square' and 'side, direction'.

已.hint: Grew out of the same old drawing as 巳 (sì). Tell the three apart by the gap at the top: 己 jǐ open, 已 yǐ half closed, 巳 sì closed.

巴.hint: An old drawing of a big snake (one that could swallow an elephant, says an old dictionary). Now used for its sound: 尾巴, 嘴巴, 巴黎.

黎.hint: 黍 (millet, a sticky grain) gives the meaning; the top right is a shortened 利 (lì), which gives the sound. Now mostly in 黎明 dawn and 巴黎 Paris.

业.hint: Simplified from 業: the toothed board on a rack where bells and drums hung. Later a task or line of work: 作业, 职业, 毕业.

齐.hint: Simplified from 齊, ears of grain standing all the same height: even, all together. The top only looks like 文.

伤.hint: Simplified from 傷: 亻 (person) gives the meaning, a hurt person. The right side, once the sound part, is now a short stroke over 力.

向.hint: A house with a window (口) in the wall; the stroke on top is the roof peak. A window faces one way: to face, towards.

乎.hint: An old drawing of breath or a sound rising: the strokes on top are the breath. Used as a particle: 似乎, 在乎.

牙.hint: An old drawing of back teeth (molars) meeting, top and bottom: tooth.

择.hint: 扌 (hand) gives the meaning: to pick out by hand. The right side is a short form of 睪 (yì), once the sound part (擇 → 择). 译 has the same right side.

万.hint: The old form 萬 was a drawing of a scorpion, borrowed for the number ten thousand. 万 is an old short form that replaced it.

而.hint: An old drawing of a beard: the top line is the chin, the strokes below are hairs. Borrowed as a word: and, but (而且, 然而).

气.hint: Three wisps of steam or cloud drifting in the air: air, gas. The first stroke only looks like part of a person.

介.hint: A person (人) between two plates of armour: in between, to come between (介绍 introduce).

友.hint: Two right hands (又) side by side: friends helping each other. The top hand is now written ナ. 又 (yòu) also gives the sound.

司.hint: A person raising an arm and giving orders with the mouth (口): to manage (公司 company).

年.hint: Once 禾 (grain) over 人 (a person): someone carrying the harvest home. One harvest, one year.

经.hint: 纟 (silk thread) gives the meaning: the long threads on a loom, so 'pass through'. The right side is a short form of 巠 (jīng), which gives the sound (經 → 经).

北.hint: Two people (each like 匕) sitting back to back. It meant 'turn your back', then the side your back faces in the sun: north.

左.hint: A left hand (the ナ on top) holding 工, a tool: left, and to help. Compare 右, the hand over 口.

黑.hint: A face blackened by soot from the fire (灬) below: black.

惠.hint: 心 (heart) under 叀, a spindle turned with care: a careful, kind heart. Kindness, favour (优惠 discount).

往.hint: 彳 (step) gives the meaning: to go. The right side looks like 主, but was a foot (止) over 王 (wáng), which gave the sound.

先.hint: A foot (止, the top) stepping out in front of a person (儿): first, before.

旅.hint: 方 and the stroke over it are an old flag; the people below are marching under it. An army on the move, then a journey (旅游).

春.hint: 日 (sun) gives the meaning. The top is a squeezed form of 艸 (grass) and 屯 (tún), which gave the sound: plants pushing up in the spring sun.

足.hint: 口 here is the knee cap, not a mouth; below is 止, a foot, written a little differently: leg, foot.

赛.hint: 贝 (shell, money) gives the meaning: a thank-you offering to the gods, later a contest. The top is 塞 (sài) without its 土, which gives the sound.

赢.hint: Five parts, top to bottom and left to right. 贝 (shell, money) gives the meaning: to gain, to win.

紧.hint: 糸 (silk thread) gives the meaning: thread pulled tight. The top is a hand (又) holding something firmly, a short form of 臤 (qiān), which gave the sound.

译.hint: 讠 (speech) gives the meaning: turn speech into another language. The right side is a short form of 睪 (yì), which gave the sound (譯 → 译). 择 has the same right side.

览.hint: 见 (see) gives the meaning: to look over (游览, 展览). The top is a short form of 监 (jiān), which gave the sound (覽 → 览).

步.hint: Two feet, one in front of the other: 止 on top, and below another foot, flipped (it only looks like 少): a step.

节.hint: Simplified from 節 (⺮ bamboo + 即 jí, the sound). The bamboo top became 艹, the rest 卩: the joints of bamboo, so 'section, festival'.

声.hint: Simplified from 聲: 声, a stone chime on its frame; 殳, a hand striking it; and 耳, the ear hearing: sound. Only the chime is left.

皮.hint: A hand (又) stripping the hide off an animal: skin.

段.hint: A hand with a chisel (殳) cutting stone from a cliff (the left side): a piece, a section.
